page.overview:
What is Landorus?

Tornadus is an orange-colored Pokémon with three pink horns and markings on its body. It has white hair on its head in a somewhat rectangular shape, and it also has hair on its face. Its eyes are yellow and it has small pupils. It has a long, brown tail with twelve flat protrusions on it, and each of them have a pink tip.

In Incarnate form, it is somewhat humanoid and the hair on its face resembles a mustache. Its lower torso consists of a cloud.

In Therian form, it becomes quadrupedal and resembles a tiger. The hair on its face resembles whiskers. There are clouds around its paws, which have three pink claws each. It also has a yellow diamond-shaped gem on its navel.

Landorus and its brothers appeared in Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 1 and Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 2, and again (in his Therian Forme) in Unova's Survival Crisis!.
